name: Prusa MK3.5 MMU3 0.4 nozzle
machine_start_gcode:
M17 ; enable steppers
M862.1 P[nozzle_diameter] A{(printer_notes=~/.*ABRASIVE_NOZZLE.*/ ? 1 : 0)} F{(printer_notes=~/.*HF_NOZZLE.*/ ? 1 : 0)} ; nozzle check
M862.3 P "MK3.5" ; printer model check
M862.5 P2 ; g-code level check
M862.6 P"Input shaper" ; FW feature check
M862.6 P "MMU3" ; FW feature check
M115 U6.4.0+11974
; setup MMU
M708 A0x1e X12  ; Pulley current to ~200mA

M555 X{(min(print_bed_max[0], first_layer_print_min[0] + 32) - 32)} Y{(max(0, first_layer_print_min[1]) - 4)} W{((min(print_bed_max[0], max(first_layer_print_min[0] + 32, first_layer_print_max[0])))) - ((min(print_bed_max[0], first_layer_print_min[0] + 32) - 32))} H{((first_layer_print_max[1])) - ((max(0, first_layer_print_min[1]) - 4))}

G90 ; use absolute coordinates
M83 ; extruder relative mode

M140 S{first_layer_bed_temperature[initial_tool]} ; set bed temp
M104 S170 ; set extruder temp for bed leveling
M109 R170 ; wait for temp
M190 S{first_layer_bed_temperature[initial_tool]} ; wait for bed temp


G28 ; home all

G29 P1 ; invalidate mbl & probe print area
G29 P1 X23 Y5 W160 H20 C ; probe near purge place
G29 P3.2 ; interpolate mbl probes
G29 P3.13 ; extrapolate mbl outside probe area
G29 A ; activate mbl

; prepare for purge
M104 S{first_layer_temperature[initial_tool]}
G0 X0 Y-4 Z15 F4800 ; move away and ready for the purge
M109 S{first_layer_temperature[initial_tool]}

T[initial_tool]
G1 E{parking_pos_retraction + extra_loading_move} F1000 ; load to the nozzle

; Extrude purge line

G92 E0 ; reset extruder position
G0 E7 X15 Z0.2 F500 ; purge
G0 X105 E36 F500 ; purge
G0 X115 E4 F650 ; purge
G0 X125 E4 F800 ; purge
G0 X128 Z0.05 F8000 ; wipe, move close to the bed
G0 X131 Z0.2 F8000 ; wipe, move quickly away from the bed

G92 E0
M221 S100 ; reset flow to 100%
machine_end_gcode:
{if layer_z < max_print_height}G1 Z{z_offset+min(max_layer_z+1, max_print_height)} F720 ; Move print head up{endif}
G1 X241 Y201 F7200 ; park
{if layer_z < max_print_height}G1 Z{z_offset+min(max_layer_z+49, max_print_height)} F720 ; Move print head further up{endif}
{if has_wipe_tower}
G1 E-15 F3000
{else}
G1 E2 F5000
G1 E2 F5500
G1 E2 F6000
G1 E-15 F5800
G1 E-20 F5500
G1 E10 F3000
G1 E-10 F3100
G1 E10 F3150
G1 E-10 F3250
G1 E10 F3300
{endif}

M140 S0 ; turn off heatbed
M107 ; turn off fan

; Unload filament
M702

G4 ; wait
M221 S100 ; reset flow
M572 S0 ; reset LA
M104 S0 ; turn off temperature
M84 ; disable motors
; max_layer_z = [max_layer_z]
printer_notes:
Don't remove the following keywords! These keywords are used in the "compatible printer" condition of the print and filament profiles to link the particular print and filament profiles to this printer profile.
PRINTER_MODEL_MK3.5
PRINTER_MODEL_MK3.5MMU3
No MK4-family ramming marker on purpose (it must never be added to these notes): PrusaSlicer's MK3.5 MMU3 uses neither cold ramming nor the ramming delay nor stuck-filament monitoring.
